justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/Attributes.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/Element.java, src/test/java/org/jsoup/nodes/AttributesTest.java, and src/test/java/org/jsoup/nodes/ElementTest.java. Dataset is a private static inner class created only by Attributes.dataset() at Attributes.java:493-494; no other production class references it directly, so fan-in is essentially zero outside its enclosing class. Its fan-out is also limited: it only depends on Attributes, AbstractMap/AbstractSet, Iterator, Map.Entry, and Attribute inside the same file (Attributes.java:618-670). The public usage in Element.dataset() merely delegates to Attributes.dataset() (Element.java:325-326), and tests exercise the public API rather than depending on Dataset itself. This is not hub-like modularization.
